cases.name: citations resolve against the filesystem again
caught_by: a cited file on disk that git does not track is reported

cases.name: a tracked file is not recognised
cases.old:
if cited in known:
        return True
caught_by: a cited file git tracks resolves

cases.name: a cited directory no longer resolves
cases.old:
prefix = cited.rstrip("/") + "/"
    return any(name.startswith(prefix) for name in known)

cases.name: git failing is read as an empty index rather than no answer
caught_by: a file whose every citation resolves passes
a by that cites only the caveat itself is not a failure
a verdict with no by at all does not crash
a by of null does not crash
